paragraphs: R. Yaakov bar Abba, Abaye's student. In the chapter Ellu Metzi'ot, he came before Abaye and asked him about barrels of wine he had found, etc., and he said to him, 'Take them for yourself' (23b). Perhaps he is the same one who spoke with Rava and Abaye. Yuḥasin gave each a separate section. Perhaps the one at the beginning of Ellu Metzi'ot is called 'R. Yaakov,' while the one in the chapter Arvei Pesaḥim and in Zevaḥim is called 'Rav Yaakov'; yet the aforementioned Eruvin has 'R. Yaakov.' According to Yuḥasin there would be three R. Yaakov bar Abbas: one Rav's student, one Rava's, and one Abaye's. Perhaps Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba is his brother. R. Yaakov bar Abba, in R. Aḥa's name, Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 42.
